course.title: Project Financing and Construction Marketing
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A Bangladesh-led consortium of investor is preparing a proposal to be submitted to the Government of a neighboring country to design, build, finance and operate a new water supply plant project. What should be the key considerations with regard to the viability of the project? What are the key risk factors that could cause uncertainty in the project's cash flows during the construction and operation period?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
